subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Does the documented no-go complete this shared route-entry investigation, or should one specific second cross-route import boundary be measured?
rationale: The planned first extraction was executed correctly and failed its size gate; no accepted source-backed next candidate exists, so further work is a discretionary performance-investment choice.

options.title: Accept the measured no-go
options.body: Treat the completed experiment as the intended outcome, preserve its measurements, and close without a code change.

options.title: Sponsor one second A/B
options.body: Name one concrete heavy import boundary and require the same manifest-closure, SSR, hydration, and cold-navigation measurements before expanding scope.

recommendation.title: Accept the measured no-go
recommendation.body: Treat the completed experiment as the intended outcome, preserve its measurements, and close without a code change.
